pages.title: Nova Creature
pages.heading: A living studio for building serious web products.
pages.intro: Nova Creature turns prompts into planned, tested, multi-page websites with memory, critique, and a quality gate built in.
pages.focus: Start with the big promise, the system signal, and a direct route into the rest of the site.

pages.title: About Nova Creature
pages.heading: Seven brain roles working as one product studio.
pages.intro: The system blends planning, memory, design, coding, critique, simulation, and final speech so every build has a route and a review loop.
pages.focus: Explain the operating model with confidence and plain language.

pages.title: Nova Agents
pages.heading: Specialized agents for building, testing, and improving.
pages.intro: The Website Builder Agent plans page count, writes every route, checks quality, and reports the next enhancements before handoff.
pages.focus: Show the agent library as an active production system, not a placeholder.

pages.title: Nova Projects
pages.heading: Sandbox projects that can be opened and tested.
pages.intro: Generated sites, games, and tools are saved as real project folders with direct preview links and traceable audits.
pages.focus: Give visitors proof that Nova ships concrete files, not just chat text.

pages.title: Nova Research
pages.heading: Modern quality standards baked into the build.
pages.intro: The baseline includes Core Web Vitals, WCAG 2.2, responsive layout, and Baseline compatibility so each page starts from current expectations.
pages.focus: Make the quality standard visible and credible.
